### Öner tarihy men mädenietter

Groups: 14 · Skills: 59

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Artworks and artistic practices develop within particular communities, historical debates, patrons and material technologies.
